description: This file defines the ChainLoader class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for loading templates from multiple loaders, managing cache, and handling template existence and freshness checks.

classes.name: ChainLoader
classes.description: A final class implementing LoaderInterface that loads templates from multiple loaders, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: addLoader
methods.description: Adds a new loader to the chain.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the array of loaders in the chain.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source context of a template by name, trying each loader.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template exists in any of the loaders, with caching.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Gets the cache key for a template, trying each loader.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is fresh (up-to-date) in any loader.
